approved_design.use: Read-only design provenance; not a checker runtime input.

instructional_audit.structure: Five 20-point cases, twenty explicit scored prompts and complete paired solutions, additive per-part rubrics totaling 100; standard exercises and solutions markers; all other IDs namespaced.
instructional_audit.administration: Original closed-book, exact hand-solvable paper. The 300-minute allowance is explicitly uncalibrated. Advancement requires 85 overall, 15 in each domain, critical-error repair, unfamiliar transfer and teach-back.
instructional_audit.ownership_timing: Separate case budgets cannot be pooled. Prizes are endowed; goods transfer precedes exchange; service benefits are not cash; wages use a precommitted escrow; buyer fees precede output; matching spillovers create no transfer or consent right.
instructional_audit.coverage: All twelve chapters map to actual bounded tasks. The manuscript identifies deeper untested theorems and chapter exercises, without asserting all frontier results or institutional equivalence.
instructional_audit.source_scope: Fifteen canonical method references reuse the explicitly attributed accepted scopes. This task inspected provenance records, not new primary bodies or images. All laws, cases, prompts and rubrics are original.

prompt_solution_audit.review: Global equal-price optimization for both complete rationalizers; changed-price bundles reverse their ranking. Two observations do not identify a whole preference.

Positive-price global demand and weighted AM–GM duality include zero income/target. The compensated Hessian, price-null vector and additional required wealth are checked without inventing a compensating payer.
State/signal dimensions, independent flip, Bayes denominators, both signal-optimal actions and the entire uninformed tie are derived. The provider owns every delivered good.

For every finite randomized decision matrix D, PGD=QD statewise; maximization and linearity give the one-way value inequality. Squaring preserves sure comparisons but changes the displayed lottery order.

Global Cobb demands yield the entire positive-price family on the owned transfer interval. Zero-wealth endpoint demand is explicit; a free good prevents a maximum for a positive-wealth household, excluding boundary prices.

Both households’ prices, incomes and commodities reconcile at the two transfers. The fixed-price redistribution derivative is distinguished from changing owned wealth and the endogenous equilibrium price.

Weak preference gives a cost lower bound by local nonsatiation when wealth is positive and automatically at zero; strict preference costs more. The expenditure contradiction and separate individual utility-cube comparisons resolve efficiency versus redistribution.
Walras value accounting alone does not establish vector clearing. The exact changing-price witness and failed common Engel-slope condition identify the minimum valid repairs.
Every independent support is covered: two asymmetric pure profiles, no one-sided mixing, and one interior profile. Primitive payoff expectations give provision and utility results.

Every positive-probability recommendation and alternative action is checked; linearity extends to randomized conditional deviations. Exact input use and the failed independent-marginal best reply are separate.
All four complete plans are priced at both histories. Positive first-player mixing is impossible; the two boundary Nash families are exhaustive, and every subgame selects the unique complete SPE.

Every fully mixed first-player strategy makes NV the unique second-player reply; the explicit positive tremble sequence attains the surviving profile. This is a direct strategic-form proof for this game, not a general refinement equivalence.

Both target actions have explicit global IC and IR plus the wage box. Pairwise half-space intersections independently recover the unique high-effort wage and zero low-effort wage; strict high effort is impossible at the cap.

Adding full buyer cross-report inequalities gives monotone delivery; two rent inequalities and outside options are necessary and sufficient. Minimal rents attain both revenue bounds and all prices are within actual cash.
All six monotone deterministic pairs are enumerated. Comparing their affine prior profits proves the full open-prior regimes and tie boundary, including both unfamiliar prior checks.

Both baseline optima reconcile profit, buyer and worker utility, real surplus and every priced wage state. Imposing strict effort removes H; the remaining baseline ties follow from the reduced finite menu.

All seven partial matchings and five ordered-subset reports are enumerated. The report-independent menu theorem, rather than fixed-profile proposer optimality alone, supports the partner-only incentive result.

All five report payoffs identify the exact externality threshold for fixed B. The common-scale sum and losing participant are recorded separately; the original theorem is not refuted outside its domain.

The historical rule has no report stage and sets the externality indicator to zero, so both fully specified worlds fit. Their imposed counterfactual payoffs differ; evidence must identify the externality and actual rights/opportunities.

The referee key requires a faithful claim, consequential exact witness, sufficient partner-only repair and explicit welfare/evidence/consent scope. It permits proved alternatives without demanding unrelated extensions.

proof_audit.review: Global budget and AM–GM arguments include zero boundaries; same certain-choice order does not fix a cardinal expected-utility scale. Finite Blackwell simulation retains common actions/payoffs and supplies only the requested direction. Exact arithmetic does not replace its every-rule proof.

Full transfer family derives owned wealth before demands. Direct price-boundary exclusion avoids importing unchecked existence hypotheses. The first-welfare cost argument survives zero wealth; heterogeneous Engel slopes invalidate redistribution invariance, while ordinal household comparisons remain separate.

Independent mixed support exhaustion, recommendation-contingent obedience and all contingent-plan Nash strategies are distinct objects. Necessity and attainment of strategic-form perfection use the accepted C06 fully mixed best-reply characterization; no general equivalence with sequential equilibrium is claimed.

Hidden-action IC/IR and statewise wage funding precede screening. Full finite buyer IC/IR proves monotonicity and global minimum rents; all six permitted deterministic mode pairs and open-prior regimes are exhausted. Weak tie selection, no mode lottery authority and the strict-effort change are explicit.

Complete report enumeration corroborates the accepted noncircular partner-only menu theorem without deriving strategy-proofness from proposer optimality alone. Allocation externalities change that theorem’s domain; fixed-B threshold, ordinary pair stability, a stipulated welfare scale and actual administrative evidence are not conflated.

checker_audit.entry: check(root=None), quiet import/API and silent no-argument CLI; standard library only.
checker_audit.inputs: Exactly the four runtime payloads are opened. Prior source records, blueprints, other checkers and the network are not runtime dependencies. A small nonexecuting AST parser reads the actual visible primitives/results.
checker_audit.oracles: Exact consumer budgets/Hessian, every finite signal rule and statewise garbling; independently derived owned exchange; payoff best replies and all meaningful Nash-family boundaries; worker feasible-vertex enumeration, all six buyer menus and all report inequalities; every matching/report and changed externality payoff.
checker_audit.bounds: Numeric helpers accept finite non-bool int/float/Fraction values within magnitude 10^6 and reduced denominator 10^12, not a decimal-place promise. Dimensions, simplex laws, positive prices, transfer ownership, action/mode/report domains and exact rational-square helper domain are explicit.

development_evidence.scope: Initial parser/numerical/domain development run before final author record; not claimed as a final four-file gate.

checker_audit.limits: Finite calculations corroborate full written proof review. The checker is not a theorem prover, empirical calibration or human certification.
